notes.title: Easter event, Remote Play Together and more!
notes.content:
Hello rescuers,

It's time to celebrate spring and we have some exciting news: a [b]new patch[/b] is now available for download, which includes new features, adjustments and a special [b]Easter event[/b]!

From [b]March 24th to April 30th[/b] you will find [b]special eggs hidden in the stages[/b] of [i]Rescue Party: Live![/i]. By collecting them, you will have the opportunity to obtain special in-game items, such as [b]cute skins[/b] for your favorite character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/8e80aefb8100333b94f7f9dc2e122629104b360b.png[/img]

Here the complete [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*][b]Remote Play Together[/b] function added, in order to make it easier for players to team up with their friends.
[*]Players can now play the [b]tutorial level[/b] with their friends under the story mode. This can help your new friends to play and learn at the same time!
[*]Added a set of [b]Easter skins[/b] (obtainable by collecting eggs in the levels [i]Residential District, Pinestone Canyon, Sunken Ferry, Chemical Plant, Highway Bridge[/i] and [i]Snow Mountain Park[/i]).
[*]Added a set of [b]Easter tiaras[/b] (obtainable through the tournament mode rewards).
[*]Added some [b]Easter decorations[/b] to the main menu.
[*]Changed [b]loading screen tips[/b] to be more clear. 
[*]Added tips for throwing stuff around.
[*]Added [b]highlighting to key rescue supplies[/b] to prevent players from missing key items.
[*]Added [b]star rating display[/b] for passed levels on the big map.
[*]Removing props from the backpack now requires holding the button, reducing the possibility of player misuse.
[*]Visual effects adjustment.[/list]

We are constantly working to optimize the in-game experience and we hope you will enjoy this update!

Thanks for your feedback and your support.

[i]Remember to stop by our [url=https://twitter.com/RescuePartyLive]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://discord.gg/h9G8BmjmFk]Discord channel[/url] to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.[/i]

notes.title: New update available now!
notes.content:
Hi Rescuers,

A [b]new patch[/b] for Rescue Party: Live! is now available for download.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*][b]UI[/b] adapts to different screen sizes and ratios
[*]Added the [b]keyboard custom key[/b] function
[*]Modified the [b]length[/b] of [b]game tournament[/b] and the number of levels, the original game tournament is 6 levels, now the tournament is 4 levels
[*]Fixed the problem that some [b]controllers[/b] were incompatible or unusable
[*]Casual mode [b]optimized difficulty[/b], suitable for more novice players
[*]You can now use the [b]mouse[/b] to navigate the game menu
[*]Support controllers being plugged in on the fly
[*]Optimization of [b]search buddy response speed[/b]
[*]Added four [b]graphic quality options[/b]: low, medium, high, and extra high. Users can freely choose the image quality according to their computer configuration[/list]
Thanks for your feedback and your support!

[i]Remember to stop by our [url=https://twitter.com/RescuePartyLive]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/1687730064744073]Facebook group[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/h9G8BmjmFk]Discord channel[/url] to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.[/i]

notes.title: Controller Update Log
notes.content: 1. Added PS4/PS5 and Switch Pro default controller adaptation button settings.

notes.title: 1.14 Hot fix clarifications
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/2b3615484a8a521a6b8ce424c8c8d9506d5478d8.png[/img]

Hi Rescuers,

After your reports, the team worked on the [b]first patch[/b] for Rescue Party: Live! and now it is available for download.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to Steam VR launching at the start of the game.
[*] Improved how the game identifies and re-configure input automatically during single player mode, this solves the controller issues some players are experiencing.
[*] Added a message to highlight if in multiplayer all the players use the same cross-play settings.[/list]
Thanks for your feedback and your support!

Remember to stop by our [url=https://twitter.com/RescuePartyLive]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/1687730064744073]Facebook group[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/h9G8BmjmFk]Discord channel[/url] to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.

notes.title: First DEMO is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/db421c1eeb7a19c8bf38a6e3d10fcbd41d34b3ae.png[/img]

Rescuers, it's time to show your skills and become heroes! 

The first free [b]DEMO[/b] of [b]Rescue Party: Live![/b] is now available to play during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].

From today to the 7th of October become a professional rescuer with your friends and show your skills by saving your fellow citizens!

In this demo you will be able to enjoy:

[list]
[*] A [b]Story Mode[/b] to play in solo or with your friends
[*] A [b]Championship Mode[/b] to challenge other rescuers online
[*] [b]3 Levels[/b] (fully playable)
[*] Different [b]skins[/b] to customize your hero
[/list]
We can't wait to see you in action! 

[b]Share[/b] your funniest moments and feedback with us on [url=https://twitter.com/RescuePartyLive]Twitter[/url], join our [url=https://discord.gg/h9G8BmjmFk]Discord[/url] channel or our brand new [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/rescuepartylive]Facebook[/url] group.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1662570/Rescue_Party_Live/

Stay Safe!
